contingencyProtocols.action: Spend 1 to 2 weeks at true maintenance TDEE (0 deficit/surplus). Restores metabolic rate, resets hormones, and consolidates muscle tissue before starting next phase.
Train hard 3 days before, 1–2 bodyweight sessions during, back in gym within 48h of return.
Gym Friday morning before they arrive, back Monday. 2 days off is nothing.
Full body gym sessions every 3–4 days if possible, protein non-negotiable daily.
2× bodyweight sessions per week, push to near failure, protect protein.
Accept it, treat it as a deload, return immediately after without guilt.

corePrinciples.title: Caloric & Macro Discipline
corePrinciples.description: Hit your TDEE target with ruthless precision. Protein is non-negotiable (1.8-2.2g/kg). Carbs drive performance; fats govern hormones.

corePrinciples.title: Scale Weight Noise
corePrinciples.description: Ignore daily scale spikes. Weigh daily, judge weekly via rolling 7-day averages. Sodium, hydration, and carbs dictate the noise.

corePrinciples.title: Sleep is Not Optional
corePrinciples.description: Recovery dictates growth. Under-sleeping destroys nutrient partitioning, tanks testosterone, and guarantees muscle loss during a cut.

corePrinciples.title: Progressive Overload
corePrinciples.description: Training must force adaptation. You must consistently add weight or reps. Maintenance training leads to a maintenance physique.

corePrinciples.title: Diet Breaks & Refeeds
corePrinciples.description: Never cut in a deficit for more than 14 straight weeks. Take 1-2 week maintenance breaks to reset metabolic adaptation and diet fatigue.

corePrinciples.title: Hydration Baselines
corePrinciples.description: Drink 3-4 liters daily. Dehydration drastically reduces strength output, increases joint pain, and causes wild scale weight fluctuations.

corePrinciples.title: Travel & Social Adaptation
corePrinciples.description: Trips and weekends are managed, not avoided. Adhere to Contingency Protocols to lock in battle plans without breaking momentum.

fieldManual.title: Measurement Protocol
fieldManual.content: Weigh in every morning immediately after waking up and using the restroom, before eating or drinking anything. Measure body fat visually and with calipers under the same lighting conditions every 2 weeks.

fieldManual.title: Supplement Stack
fieldManual.content: Creatine Monohydrate (5g/day), Whey Protein Isolate (as needed to hit macros), Vitamin D3, Omega-3 Fish Oil. Keep it simple and effective.

fieldManual.title: Training Split
fieldManual.content: Upper/Lower or Push/Pull/Legs depending on current recovery capacity. Focus on compound lifts: Squats, Deadlifts, Bench Press, Overhead Press, Pull-ups.

fieldManual.title: Phase Transitions
fieldManual.content: When transitioning between CUT and BULK, always take a 1-2 week maintenance break to stabilize hormones and reset your baseline weight.
